CIRCLE_METHOD_MAJOR_ARC.statement: I_major(N) = G(N)*N/log^2(N)*(1+o(1)) > 0 for all large even N.

EXPONENTIAL_SUM_POSITIVITY.notes: Major arc positivity certified; minor arc bound conditional on GRH.
EXPONENTIAL_SUM_POSITIVITY.statement: S(alpha,N) has positive major arc contribution for all large N.

GOLDBACH_CLOSURE.notes: Follows from MINOR_ARC_BOUND; closure is conditional.
GOLDBACH_CLOSURE.statement: r(N) > 0 for all even N > 2 (Goldbach holds).

GOLDBACH_RAW_TARGET.notes: Raw problem statement from Goldbach (1742), verified to 4e18 (Oliveira e Silva 2013).
GOLDBACH_RAW_TARGET.statement: For all even n > 2, exists primes p,q: n=p+q.

MINOR_ARC_BOUND.notes: UNCONDITIONAL for ternary Goldbach (Helfgott 2013). For binary: requires GRH or major open problem. THIS IS THE GAP.
MINOR_ARC_BOUND.statement: I_minor(N) = o(N/log^2(N)) — subdominant on minor arcs.

SINGULAR_SERIES_POSITIVITY.notes: Product of positive local factors; G(n) >= C > 0 unconditionally.
